1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

yang Diberikan) 2025.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 5 November 2025.

Fi dan caj

2. (1) Fi dan caj berhubung dengan apa-apa perkhidmatan yang diberikan oleh

Lembaga adalah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

(2) Fi dan caj di bawah subperaturan (1) hendaklah kena dibayar

sepenuhnya sebelum perkhidmatan diberikan oleh Lembaga.

HIGHWAY AUTHORITY MALAYSIA (INCORPORATION) ACT 1980

HIGHWAY AUTHORITY MALAYSIA (INCORPORATION) (FEES AND CHARGES FOR

SERVICES RENDERED) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 11(2)(cc) of the Highway Authority

Malaysia (Incorporation) Act 1980 [Act 231], the Authority, with the approval of the

Minister, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Highway Authority Malaysia

(Incorporation) (Fees and Charges for Services Rendered) Regulations 2025.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 5 November 2025.

Fees and charges

2. (1) The fees and charges in relation to any service rendered by the Authority

are as specified in the Schedule.

(2) The fees and charges under subregulation (1) shall be payable in full

before the service is rendered by the Authority.
